scenes.summary: Endfield Operator Thurston has discovered an attack site involving the Bonekrusher Clan in the Power Plateau area. You've decided to investigate this unusual incident together.

lines.text: Who did this...
*Gasp* E-Endmin? Apologies, I was lost in my thought...
I'm Thurston, currently assisting the Hub Base in assessing safety conditions in Valley IV.
Although we've retaken the Power Plateau, there are still some stubborn Landbreakers holding out nearby who haven't withdrawn yet.
I was worried the workers might have more accidents, so I prioritized investigating this area. And then... I found this.
This spot wasn't on our original counterattack route, yet there are quite a few Landbreakers down here.
So they were killed by someone unknown, at a time we didn't know about.
The Bonekrushers getting weakened is definitely a win for us, but those attackers aren't necessarily on our side.
A major battle just wrapped up, and everyone's beat. Any wildcard out there is a straight-up threat.
You're right. Everyone's exhausted now. I'm really worried something unexpected might happen.
Need to get closer to confirm more intel. And somehow get past these obstacles...
You're willing to help? Thank you so much! Let's get started then!

options: The enemy of my enemy isn't necessarily a friend.

scenes.summary: Thurston has found another Bonekrusher attack site in the Power Plateau area, but you'll need to find a way into the scene first.

lines.text: The scene keeps getting more extreme...
This area doesn't seem to be on our assault route. The counterattack team's after-action reports don't mention this place either.
The incident likely occurred before we launched our counterattack. But back then, this area should've been swarming with Bonekrushers...
Combined with the earlier anomalies, many things must have happened in places we're unaware of.
A major battle just ended. We can't afford to overlook any potential threats now.
Understood, I'll check if there's a passable route nearby first.

options: This definitely isn't something an average person could pull off.
Whoever they are, they're unfathomably skilled.
Could be internal strife within the Bonekrusher Clan.
Let's find a way to get closer for evidence collection.

scenes.summary: Thurston recognizes the dead Landbreaker elite: "Volcano" Chacha, one of the most influential leaders of the Bonekrusher Clan. He once commanded substantial forces and had significant friction with Rhodagn.

lines.text: My goodness, is he... "Volcano" Chacha?!
Before the recent large-scale internal consolidation, "Volcano" was one of the most influential leaders in the Bonekrusher Clan.
He used his strength to conquer many scattered forces within the clan, launching dozens of attacks on small settlements and merchant convoys.
Actually, yes. Even we knew about the conflict between "Volcano" and "Bonekrushing Fist". Their factions clashed frequently.
"Volcano" claimed no one on earth could rival him. While that's exaggerated, his strength was truly formidable.
Looking at it this way, the Bonekrushers practically went all-in in Valley IV... That's a steep price to pay.

options: He just sounds like Rhodagn number two.

lines.text: A sharp dagger lies on the ground, its blade still stained with blood.
The blade appears slightly warped, as if it blocked some massive energy impact.

scenes.summary: Thurston believes "Volcano" was betrayed by "Shadow" and abandoned by other allies.

lines.text: The area's too badly damaged by Ætherside bursts. Good thing you managed to extract the terminal data anyway.
A secret meeting. "Volcano" and that "Shadow" met here ... and never left.
The man who claimed no rivals on this land died here ... feels like some kind of twisted joke.
A failed plan. He was betrayed. Not just by "Shadow", but also by those so-called "friends" "Shadow" mentioned.
Who do you think that note was meant for, Endmin?
Really? Something still feels off...
Given the tone of the note, there really aren't many people with higher authority than "Volcano".
"Guillotine", "Will-o-Wisp", "Bloodeye"... So many others tied to this incident.
Let's leave the deep analysis to the experts back at base. There might still be undiscovered intel in Valley IV. We need to dig it all up.
True enough...

options: What do you think happened here?
Nefarith. She is the leader after all.
It's too early to jump to conclusions.

lines.text: Huh? This blade ... seems odd.
If I remember correctly, this is the type of weapon used by elites among the Landbreakers.
They almost never abandon their "second life", yet they just tossed it aside like this...
Hard to say for now... I'll check ahead, might find something different.

options: Maybe it was used as bait?
